entries.note: Soren reads as a frontier warden-engineer: oatmeal reinforced coat, leather protection, restrained spear scale, and tool pouches preserve workman identity.
Sigrid reads as a mobile pathfinder: dark tied hair, plaid weather cape, matte brigandine, compact bow, and short utility blade remain practical and distinct.
The Mireback scene has clear teamwork and physical action. Exact l001/l002 plate layout was not tested because those new outputs were not authorized as further ImageGen reference uploads.

provisional_direction.soren: Retain oatmeal as the dominant value and evolve via removable work-derived protection, tools, and a modest reach weapon.
provisional_direction.sigrid: Retain the plaid as the dominant motion shape and integrate light dark armor, bow, and short utility blade beneath it.
provisional_direction.monster: Favor material-causal creatures whose mass, joints, weak surfaces, and interaction with terrain support readable tactics; the peat/root/slate Mireback is a promising motif.
provisional_direction.litrpg_energy: Express class progression through equipment function, tactics, and silhouette before adding interface text or spectacle.

limitations: Concept images are not CH05 canon and do not revise current wardrobe.
